steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Leave it to me... You've traveled far to bring her home.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: I will take care of the rest personally.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ashes... and her personal effects.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There hasn't been an emergency transmission to Rhodes Island's deck for eleven months and twenty-seven days, since the end of the Chernobog incident.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Who's the victim?

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Outcast.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right. I see you holding her revolver's cylinder.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't want to admit it, but I already knew the answer. I figured it out on our way here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I made a bet with her once—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And it looks like she won.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Kal'tsit, I won't be at that next meeting.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Per protocol, you're in charge of an elite operator's funeral...

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: But I want to be the one to send her off this time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I doubt anyone will object. Definitely not her.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Since the meeting's canceled, I'll give you my final decision right now—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I know what you're going to say.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Then I'm sure you know what everyone else will say.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: The situation has changed. No one's happy about it, but we all know this is the only choice we have.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: —We have to enter Londinium as soon as we can.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm sure you know that my position has always been the same—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But regardless of whether the rest of you support my decision or not, I must emphasize that Rhodes Island's direction will not be set on the airing of personal feelings.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: You're telling me to forget about avenging Outcast?

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Don't worry. I'm angry and hurt, but I know my job.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: It's just... I need to see for myself what it was that killed Outcast—

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: It couldn't have been just one person, or even several of them.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Suppose we don't go looking for the truth. The darkness shrouding Londinium, and even all of Victoria, is only going to get worse.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: And at that point, it won't just be Outcast...

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: I'll die. We all will. No one will be safe.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Just like you said, Rhodes Island isn't about avenging the dead...

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: But I am sure we all want to let the living live.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Er... Where am I now? Did I make another wrong turn?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Oh, whoops! It's almost time. I have to hurry... *sigh*, Uncle Oliver never told me how big this ship was!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Huh? Are you...?!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Wait, please! Hold on!

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Why doesn't she seem to know me at all?)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (No, it couldn't be anyone else.)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (I've been meaning to find out what happened to her ever since I came to the ship, but they either didn't know or wouldn't tell me.)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Hmm... Maybe it's for the best, for her own safety?)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: A—Are you reading? 'The Legend of Ivanhoe'... I've read it too. It's one of my favorites.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Don't you think this part of Victorian history makes for a really fun read?

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: Is it... fun? I suppose... but it's not real.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: It's a novel... That's all.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Right... I suppose that is true. Do you want to read something else, too? I have lots of books... Oh. No, sorry. It slipped my mind I didn't bring any of them with me...

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: If you like this one... you can have it.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Huh? Are you sure? Th-Thanks...

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: I'll be... going now.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Oh, okay! Bye!

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (Will we see each other again?)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: (She has another book on her... A poetry collection?)

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Seamus Williams... The name rings a bell, and I think I've seen that cover before.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: This must be the place...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I—Identification code? What is that? Is it in the 'New Operator Guide?'

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Ugh, I don't want to be late. I'll just knock.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Come in!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good afternoon, Miss Willow... or should I call you Operator Saileach?

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: Oh... Miss Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please, just Amiya. That's what everyone calls me here.

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: I'm sorry about this, Amiya... You're so busy, I shouldn't have you cut into your work to come see me. When I did my physical the other day, I heard you only got about five hours off a day...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Folinic's always so worried about my health. Don't worry, though. I'm in excellent shape, and I've actually wanted to see you again for some time.

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: So this used to be Outcast's office...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, but she didn't get a lot of use out of it. We only just convinced her to accept a title change two months before the incident.

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: She told me she was essentially half-retired before she came to County Hillock...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But she still insisted on taking the mission.

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: I often think back to everything she told me in those few days... I think she had probably made up her mind, already, to take on everything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's just like her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All our elite operators are pretty eccentric, but Outcast's particularly special—She makes the kinds of difficult decisions that others would have a hard time with.

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: Right, she told me... she gave up a really high position in the church because she failed to mediate peace in a war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm... I know she left the church, but a failed mediation?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't remember seeing that in her file. Actually, that sounds more like something that happened to Misery.

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: Ha... haha... I don't know why, but taking someone else's story sounds like something she'd do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This may be why some people found Outcast a little insincere...

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: No, even if you tell me not everything she said was the truth, she's still the most sincere person I've ever met.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You really think so? Hmm... I'm not too surprised. Outcast's always had an eye for people.

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: I know your time is precious... but would you mind telling me more about her?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't mind at all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is going to take some time, though—

steps.name: Saileach
steps.text: As long as you have time. I'll always be willing to listen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay. I think... we'll have lots of time on our way to Londinium.
Several months later...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you done fixing that yet?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, keep your head on. What's the rush? This town's so far from anywhere, it's tough to find a replacement circuit for our comms...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let me do it. Any equipment you touch always goes up in smoke. That's never changed.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I mean, it's been forever since the last time this safe house was used...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I should never have listened to you and taken this route.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We've been drifting all over the place for the last few months, and we spent half that time in the middle of nowhere, eating sand!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's only been a few years... How come my Chenchen's so much angrier in the eyes there?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop mumbling... I can hear every word. You've got the loudest whisper.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What's the rush, she says? Why aren't you in a rush?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You know how long we've been out here? Forget the spectre force. We haven't found anything that even resembles a clue!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If I ran into a situation like this back when I was a cop in Lungmen, I would have told you to give up... No hostage would last this long.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I know the captain's still alive.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And likewise, she knows I'm doin' everythin' I can to save her, and I know she's lookin' for a way to regroup with me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Eh, fine, whatever. There's no helping you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If I could talk you out of anything, you wouldn't have been dragging me all over the place.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Just goes to show how sweet you are on me, Chenchen!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Enough, I understand persistence. All those years, back when I had my heart set on finding her, you always supported me... Anyway, let's not talk about this right now.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: —The point is, you heard it yourself.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The County Hillock Incident's a military drill gone wrong. That's what they told the public.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Everyone who's hurt or sick will receive compensation and be resettled. According to government documents, anyway.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If Dublinn, or the spectre force, had taken over County Hillock when you left, then they've long since left the place without a trace.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not going to change, even if we go back to see it for ourselves.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I agree.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But I still remember everythin' I saw there. No matter how peaceful their things might seem, County Hillock... and the cities around it have gone through a great change.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Besides... isn't it all the more scary, when you think about how those changes are so well hidden in plain sight?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: If the enemy chose to lay low after they made such a huge ruckus, that just says they're brewin' an even bigger scheme!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Victoria... might be lookin' at a crisis way bigger than the Hillock situation.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's why I'm here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But I'm not sure there are many more out there who do.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: That's why we need to work harder!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Then I guess we need to figure a way into the big cities.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you remember Hughes?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The, um... the round one who tripped and bumped his head just about anywhere in trainin'?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: He's the vice-chairman of Tradersmill City's Business Alliance.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If any of our classmates caught wind of anything on the down low, it's him.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Actually, before you even brought it up, I'd been thinkin' of askin' Hughes to help... No, not just Hughes. I wanted to try Big Green, Ginger Bill... and all the rest!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I've tried findin' them myself... It was plenty tough, though...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But now I've got you here, plus the supplies and intel support that Rhodes Island so generously provides—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So I'm pumped up on hope!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Let me warn you first. I have no idea how easily they'll be convinced—Huh?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Bloody son of a... Why'd you yank me that hard?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Chenchen, the transmitter's on!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: An emergency message from Rhodes Island...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They got our location before the transmitter broke, right? Could they have been trying to reach me...?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What's the matter? You look like that message socked you straight in the gut...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, I think I get it... Is it about her?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure enough...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I need some time to think about what's to come.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica, how's the mission going?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm on the road already.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't let your guard down.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Relax, Liskarm... I may not have been back to Victoria much, but we have entry permissions for our aircraft. The navigation system is working fine, too.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Our mission to escort the expats back to Columbia isn't difficult in itself, but the situation could change at any moment.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I was actually pretty surprised when we got their message, though...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The journey's been pretty much smooth sailing so far, but... have things really gotten so bad?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Phew... Sorry, I couldn't really show it when the captain and the rest of the team was there, but I'm actually rather nervous about this.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Your captain's not there...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh, no. She left with a few others not long after we'd got to Victoria.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I guess... they might have another mission?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There's obviously a reason that the expat evacuation was assigned to the Department of Equipment and Applied Technologies.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I-Is there an obvious reason?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: It's not necessarily a bad thing that you haven't noticed.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Do you mean... they are still having discussions with others?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But the Victorian government hasn't given us any orders...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Per the confidentiality agreement, I shouldn't be speculating or commenting on the other departments' information.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Forget what I said.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Focus on your mission, and let me know if anything comes up.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Remember, although this mission is Blacksteel's, our agreement with Rhodes Island still stands.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Alright! I got it!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Once Rhodes Island's squads make it to the outskirts of Londinium, I will rendezvous with them, as needed.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We're getting close...

options: We've waited so long for this day.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: A few months ago, Dr. Kal'tsit asked me if I was ready.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And I told her, I didn't know.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And I still don't know, even now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: So, I can't say for sure that I'm not nervous.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doctor, thank you for staying with me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If I'm still here seeking the quiet by your side... does that make it seem like I'm hiding from my problems?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Ever since the day I escaped, yeah, I've been waiting for the chance to return.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I can't help but wonder... If someone's gone for too long from where they belonged before, do they still really have a place to go home?

options: When I woke up, I didn't even know how long it'd been since I left.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I heard about those days.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You'd just awakened, and right away you had to take command and go through everything that happened at Chernobog... Most people couldn't have handled things as well as you did.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Amiya... Doctor, you're family to her.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Rhodes Island needs you. All of us operators need you as well. There's no doubt about it.

options: I'm sure someone is waiting for you in Londinium too.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Glasgow Gang must have a new leader by now. They could never have set roots down in Londinium without one.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: As for the others...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I doubt my absence has left Londinium wanting.

options: If you want the answer, we must keep going.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You told me before... you wanted to go to Londinium to find the truth.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Are we all bound for there together?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It really does lighten me up, knowing I won't take this journey alone.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I hope the answer that lies ahead won't be one too ugly.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But whatever it is, I will do my best to shape it into something half decent with my hammer.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: Have they arrived?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Soon, Your Majesty. The Nachzehrer King and the Vampires' Prince of Blood will arrive in Londinium in three days.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: With the court reassembled, the Sarkaz have not been so close to reunification since before the civil war.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: We mustn't let any other factions get in the way.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Speaking of other factions, Your Majesty, the envoy from County Hillock is still in Londinium.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: We've already reached a conclusion on that.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: It's just as you said, Your Majesty. They don't truly wish to form an alliance.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Had they such a motive, they wouldn't send a lunatic of a servant in their place as they hide whole behind the curtain.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: There is no chance she lays hands on what she wants, but that is not why she left. The force she brought with her has been involved in multiple skirmishes with noble remnants and local residents in Londinium's outskirts.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: They're probing the situation in Londinium, as well as evaluating our strength.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Yes, Your Majesty. If we appear weak, the powers behind her will step onto the stage sooner.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Yet if we take a strong approach, she will lose her value as a pawn, and face a hasty disposal.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: All those who would wield the blade that is the Sarkaz will find themselves slain by that very blade.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: She is not even in the same class as Talulah.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: They may come from similar bloodlines, but Dublinn's leader and Talulah are nothing alike.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Compared to Reunion, the troubles that Dublinn stirs in the south have more than proven their strength. And it proves they are either ready to or are preparing to rip Victoria apart.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: If one seeks to kick a man when he's down, one will only appear at the climax of the chaos.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: At this stage, so long as the objective before us has nothing to do with the Sarkaz, no matter what they are scheming outside, they are unworthy of my attention.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: But I will not allow any more chaos in Londinium.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: Have Manfred do something about this. Dealing with the nobles is far too simple a task for him. He needs growth, and he needs it fast.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Manfred has always known how you feel. He's made the preparations.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: Still not enough. Any movement from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: For the past few months, their usual, so-called 'commercial activities' have proceeded apace.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Ever since their landship sailed off from Kazimierz late last year, they've come close to Victoria several times. Since then, they've scarcely left our watchful eyes, and never for long.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: As soon as they near Londinium... No, as soon as the few of them enter Victoria, report to me at once.

steps.name: Regent
steps.text: Or perhaps you may report to her directly.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Of course, Your Majesty—The King of Sarkaz knows how to reclaim her promised crown.
